rationale: The workflow already caches npm dependencies via actions/setup-node@v5 with cache: npm, which satisfies the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-cache pattern; adding a separate actions/cache step would duplicate an existing cache, triggering the pattern's contraindication (An equivalent cache already exists). P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because this is a deployment workflow (release/deployment work). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is inapplicable because there is no matrix strategy. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT offers no clear benefit: all five recorded CI runs completed successfully in about 2.5-3 minutes, there is no evidence of stuck or runaway jobs, and imposing an arbitrary timeout could interrupt valid slow runs (cold cache, network delays). No other pattern fits the workflow structure without weakening coverage or introducing unrelated changes.
